Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 14
Reason for Mistake: The Planner prematurely accepted a misleading search snippet that claimed “Ben Affleck as Benny O’Donnell” and anchored on that as the expected result without verifying on authoritative sources (IMDb/Wikipedia). This misinterpretation led to repeated, redundant instructions and set the investigation on the wrong track. In reality, Ben Affleck played Fred O’Bannion (Benny O’Donnell was played by Cole Hauser).
